svg.text: I agents now read, write and delete real data, and most teams have no

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: gate between the model deciding and the action happening. When

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: something goes wrong there is no record of what was allowed, who

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: AgentIssue sits between the agent and the resource. Every action is evaluated

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: first and the answer is allow, ask a human, or block. Only an allowed action runs,

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: exactly once, and every decision lands in a signed audit trail.
